title: Where Do LLM Ensemble Gains Come From? Decomposing Candidate Value, Diversity, and Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.18786v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM ensemble gains are often measured against a single baseline, but the value attributed to additional candidates can change with the comparison used. We study an LLM aggregator under four matched conditions: Direct (no candidates), Single-slot (one candidate in a multi-slot interface), Duplicate (one candidate repeated), and Multi-candidate (separately generated candidates). Under either non-diverse control, overall candidate gain (CIV) splits algebraically into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV); the split, but not CIV, depends on the chosen control. On MultiHopRAG model diversity (k=2), the repetition gap Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] quantifies the difference between gains measured against Duplicate and Single-slot. On a matched FRAMES stronger-panel extension (n=200, k=3, aggregator output limit 4096), paired Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]; within panels, Rep changes sign (original -6

translated_title: LLM集成增益从何而来？分解候选价值、多样性与聚合
translated_abstract: LLM集成增益通常相对于单一基线进行测量，但归因于额外候选的价值会随着所采用的比较方式而改变。我们在四种匹配条件下研究LLM聚合器：Direct（无候选）、Single-slot（多槽界面中仅有一个候选）、Duplicate（同一候选重复出现）和Multi-candidate（独立生成的多个候选）。在任一非多样性控制条件下，总体候选增益（CIV）可在代数上分解为额外候选对比（DSV）与候选上下文对比（CCV）；这一分解（而非CIV本身）取决于所选的控制条件。在MultiHopRAG的模型多样性设置（k=2）中，重复差距 Rep=-8.33 pp [-13.25, -3.75] 量化了以Duplicate与Single-slot为基线所测增益之间的差异。在匹配的FRAMES更强面板扩展实验中（n=200, k=3, 聚合器输出限制4096），配对Delta Rep=+9.67 pp [+6.00, +13.50]；而在面板内部，Rep的符号发生反转（原始-6……
tldr: 该论文提出将LLM集成的总体候选增益（CIV）代数分解为额外候选对比（DSV）和候选上下文对比（CCV），并通过四种匹配的实验条件证明重复差距会随基线选择和实验设置而改变符号，表明集成增益的度量高度依赖于所选的对照方式。
en_tdlr: This paper algebraically decomposes LLM ensemble candidate gains (CIV) into an additional-candidate contrast (DSV) and a candidate-context contrast (CCV), showing via four matched experimental conditions that the repetition gap changes sign across baselines and settings, demonstrating that ensemble gain measurements depend on the chosen control.
